+import { describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { QueryCache, QueryClient, createPersisterRestoreResult } from '..'
+
+describe('createPersisterRestoreResult', () => {
+  test('should adopt the restored state instead of a fresh success', async () => {
+    const onSuccess = vi.fn()
+    const onSettled = vi.fn()
+    const client = new QueryClient({
+      queryCache: new QueryCache({ onSuccess, onSettled }),
+    })
+    const error = new Error('persisted')
+    const queryFn = vi.fn(() => 'fresh')
+
+    await client.prefetchQuery({
+      queryKey: ['key'],
+      queryFn,
+      persister: () =>
+        createPersisterRestoreResult({
+          data: 'restored',
+          state: {
+            data: 'restored',
+            dataUpdateCount: 2,
+            dataUpdatedAt: 10,
+            error,
+            errorUpdateCount: 3,
+            errorUpdatedAt: 20,
+            fetchFailureCount: 4,
+            fetchFailureReason: error,
+            isInvalidated: true,
+            status: 'error',
+            fetchStatus: 'fetching',
+          },
+        }),
+    })
+
+    expect(queryFn).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(onSuccess).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(onSettled).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(client.getQueryState(['key'])).toMatchObject({
+      data: 'restored',
+      dataUpdateCount: 2,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 10,
+      error,
+      errorUpdateCount: 3,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 20,
+      fetchFailureCount: 4,
+      fetchFailureReason: error,
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    })
+  })
+})

diff --git a/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/__tests__/createPersisterRestoreState.test.ts b/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/__tests__/createPersisterRestoreState.test.ts

+++ b/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/__tests__/createPersisterRestoreState.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,292 @@
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import {
+  QueryCache,
+  QueryClient,
+  QueryObserver,
+  hashKey,
+} from '@tanstack/query-core'
+import {
+  PERSISTER_KEY_PREFIX,
+  experimental_createQueryPersister,
+} from '../createPersister'
+import type { QueryKey, QueryState } from '@tanstack/query-core'
+
+function getFreshStorage() {
+  const storage = new Map<string, string>()
+  return {
+    getItem: (key: string) => Promise.resolve(storage.get(key)),
+    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => {
+      storage.set(key, value)
+      return Promise.resolve()
+    },
+    removeItem: (key: string) => {
+      storage.delete(key)
+      return Promise.resolve()
+    },
+    entries: () => Promise.resolve(Array.from(storage.entries())),
+  }
+}
+
+function persistedState(
+  overrides: Partial<QueryState<unknown, unknown>>,
+): QueryState<unknown, unknown> {
+  return {
+    data: undefined,
+    dataUpdateCount: 0,
+    dataUpdatedAt: 0,
+    error: null,
+    errorUpdateCount: 0,
+    errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+    fetchFailureCount: 0,
+    fetchFailureReason: null,
+    fetchMeta: null,
+    isInvalidated: false,
+    status: 'pending',
+    fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    ...overrides,
+  }
+}
+
+async function store(
+  storage: ReturnType<typeof getFreshStorage>,
+  queryKey: QueryKey,
+  state: QueryState<unknown, unknown>,
+) {
+  const queryHash = hashKey(queryKey)
+  await storage.setItem(
+    `${PERSISTER_KEY_PREFIX}-${queryHash}`,
+    JSON.stringify({ buster: '', queryHash, queryKey, state }),
+  )
+}
+
+describe('createPersister restored state', () => {
+  beforeAll(() => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers()
+  })
+
+  afterAll(() => {
+    vi.useRealTimers()
+  })
+
+  test('should restore a refetch error snapshot through an observer', async () => {
+    const now = Date.now()
+    const storage = getFreshStorage()
+    const queryKey = ['refetch-error']
+    const state = persistedState({
+      data: 'cached',
+      dataUpdateCount: 2,
+      dataUpdatedAt: now - 2000,
+      error: { message: 'boom' },
+      errorUpdateCount: 3,
+      errorUpdatedAt: now - 1000,
+      fetchFailureCount: 4,
+      fetchFailureReason: { message: 'boom' },
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+    })
+    await store(storage, queryKey, state)
+
+    const onSuccess = vi.fn()
+    const client = new QueryClient({
+      queryCache: new QueryCache({ onSuccess }),
+    })
+    const persister = experimental_createQueryPersister({
+      storage,
+      refetchOnRestore: false,
+    })
+    const queryFn = vi.fn(() => 'fresh')
+
+    const observer = new QueryObserver(client, {
+      queryKey,
+      queryFn,
+      persister: persister.persisterFn,
+      retry: false,
+    })
+    const unsubscribe = observer.subscribe(() => undefined)
+    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(10)
+
+    const result = observer.getCurrentResult()
+    expect(queryFn).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(onSuccess).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(result).toMatchObject({
+      data: 'cached',
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      isRefetchError: true,
+      error: { message: 'boom' },
+      failureCount: 4,
+      failureReason: { message: 'boom' },
+      errorUpdateCount: 3,
+      dataUpdatedAt: now - 2000,
+      errorUpdatedAt: now - 1000,
+    })
+    expect(client.getQueryCache().find({ queryKey })?.state).toMatchObject({
+      dataUpdateCount: 2,
+      isInvalidated: true,
+    })
+
+    unsubscribe()
+  })
+
+  test('should keep page params of restored infinite queries', async () => {
+    const now = Date.now()
+    const storage = getFreshStorage()
+    const queryKey = ['infinite']
+    await store(
+      storage,
+      queryKey,
+      persistedState({
+        data: { pages: ['a', 'b'], pageParams: [0, 1] },
+        dataUpdateCount: 1,
+        dataUpdatedAt: now - 500,
+        status: 'success',
+        isInvalidated: true,
+      }),
+    )
+
+    const client = new QueryClient()
+    const persister = experimental_createQueryPersister({
+      storage,
+      refetchOnRestore: false,
+    })
+    const queryFn = vi.fn(() => 'x')
+
+    await client.prefetchInfiniteQuery({
+      queryKey,
+      queryFn,
+      initialPageParam: 0,
+      getNextPageParam: (_last: unknown, pages: Array<unknown>) =>
+        pages.length,
+      persister: persister.persisterFn as any,
+    })
+
+    expect(queryFn).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    const query = client.getQueryCache().find({ queryKey })!
+    expect(query.state).toMatchObject({
+      data: { pages: ['a', 'b'], pageParams: [0, 1] },
+      dataUpdatedAt: now - 500,
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('should preserve full state when bulk restoring', async () => {
+    const now = Date.now()
+    const storage = getFreshStorage()
+    const errorState = persistedState({
+      data: 'one',
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      dataUpdatedAt: now - 300,
+      error: { message: 'bad' },
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      errorUpdatedAt: now - 100,
+      fetchFailureCount: 2,
+      fetchFailureReason: { message: 'bad' },
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+    })
+    const successState = persistedState({
+      data: 'two',
+      dataUpdateCount: 5,
+      dataUpdatedAt: now - 50,
+      status: 'success',
+    })
+    await store(storage, ['one'], errorState)
+    await store(storage, ['two'], successState)
+
+    const client = new QueryClient()
+    const persister = experimental_createQueryPersister({ storage })
+    await persister.restoreQueries(client)
+
+    expect(client.getQueryState(['one'])).toEqual(errorState)
+    expect(client.getQueryState(['two'])).toEqual(successState)
+
+    const observer = new QueryObserver(client, {
+      queryKey: ['one'],
+      queryFn: () => 'x',
+      staleTime: Infinity,
+      enabled: false,
+    })
+    expect(observer.getCurrentResult()).toMatchObject({
+      isRefetchError: true,
+      failureCount: 2,
+      dataUpdatedAt: now - 300,
+      errorUpdatedAt: now - 100,
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('should keep newer live data while adopting newer persisted error', async () => {
+    const now = Date.now()
+    const storage = getFreshStorage()
+    const queryKey = ['merge']
+    await store(
+      storage,
+      queryKey,
+      persistedState({
+        data: 'old',
+        dataUpdateCount: 1,
+        dataUpdatedAt: now - 1000,
+        error: { message: 'persisted' },
+        errorUpdateCount: 1,
+        errorUpdatedAt: now - 500,
+        fetchFailureCount: 1,
+        fetchFailureReason: { message: 'persisted' },
+        isInvalidated: true,
+        status: 'error',
+      }),
+    )
+
+    const client = new QueryClient()
+    client.setQueryData(queryKey, 'live', { updatedAt: now - 100 })
+
+    const persister = experimental_createQueryPersister({ storage })
+    await persister.restoreQueries(client)
+
+    expect(client.getQueryState(queryKey)).toMatchObject({
+      data: 'live',
+      dataUpdatedAt: now - 100,
+      error: { message: 'persisted' },
+      errorUpdatedAt: now - 500,
+      fetchFailureCount: 1,
+      status: 'error',
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('should keep newer persisted data while keeping newer live error', async () => {
+    const now = Date.now()
+    const storage = getFreshStorage()
+    const queryKey = ['merge-inverse']
+    await store(
+      storage,
+      queryKey,
+      persistedState({
+        data: 'persisted',
+        dataUpdateCount: 3,
+        dataUpdatedAt: now - 100,
+        status: 'success',
+      }),
+    )
+
+    const client = new QueryClient()
+    client.setQueryData(queryKey, 'live', { updatedAt: now - 1000 })
+    const query = client.getQueryCache().find({ queryKey })!
+    query.setState({
+      error: new Error('live'),
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      errorUpdatedAt: now - 50,
+      status: 'error',
+    })
+
+    const persister = experimental_createQueryPersister({ storage })
+    await persister.restoreQueries(client)
+
+    expect(client.getQueryState(queryKey)).toMatchObject({
+      data: 'persisted',
+      dataUpdatedAt: now - 100,
+      dataUpdateCount: 3,
+      error: new Error('live'),
+      errorUpdatedAt: now - 50,
+      status: 'error',
+    })
